description: Gzip byte budgets for production JS chunks (see scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs); totals.deploySizeMaxBytes is the raw dist/ size budget (see scripts/check-deploy-size.mjs).
threeChunkComment: `three` and `three.webgpu` are split again as of the WebGPU-chunk-collapse fix (manualChunks in vite.config.js routes node_modules/three/build/three.webgpu(.js), three.tsl(.js), and the examples/jsm/tsl/* addon nodes to their own 'three.webgpu' chunk before the generic node_modules/three catch-all — those addon nodes matter too: they statically import 'three/webgpu' and 'three/tsl', so leaving them in the eager chunk reintroduced both eager bytes and a chunk cycle). `three` covers the WebGL-path build of three + three's examples/jsm loaders/controls, real post-split size ~233-239 KB gzip; the budget below adds headroom pending a real tree-shake audit. `three.webgpu` is demand-loaded (see below) — WebGPU sessions only, never fetched by ?webgl (enforced by verify:bundle-loading and by static module-graph inspection: the 'three' chunk has zero imports from 'three.webgpu').
demandLoadedComment: Chunks fetched only by a subset of sessions, so they do not belong in the every-session (eager) total. Each still needs its own `chunks` budget or an explicit note below.

demandLoaded.reason: LTC BRDF tables; WebGPU at the high quality profile only (AccentLightRig.js)
WebGPU backend + TSL; WebGPU sessions only
